items.summary: Fix the monthly progression logic so that the habit named "Plank" (time unit) increases by exactly +15 seconds per calendar month (e.g., February 1:15, March 1:30, April 1:45), and the habit named "Squash" (time unit) remains constant at 45:00 for every calendar month. Do not change progression behavior for other habits.

Ensure time-based volume updates correctly preserve and/or initialize unit type as "time" so that time habits (including Plank and Squash) never compound using the default "reps" rules when a timeString is provided during an update.

Update the frontend’s optimistic volume compounding (used during volume edits) to match the corrected calendar-month rules for Plank (+15 seconds/month) and Squash (constant 45:00 across all months), while leaving other habits unchanged.
